T39: the Story committed and ONLY an approval-stamped artifact json dirty -> changedFiles is exactly the Story's source files
T39: the Story's committed ledger files (artifact json, build-start, rendered docs) are not in the reviewed set either
T40: a Story that edited .insrc/artifacts/templates/t.json (and other user-authored .insrc files) keeps them in changedFiles
T41: a base naming a commit that does not exist -> ok, the same set today's call returns, and exactly one warning
T41: with NO resolvable base the first attempt is the ledger-exclusion one — no base is invented
the resolver is asked for THIS Story's base, and that base plus the ledger globs reach the seam
T42: a seam that throws whenever excludeGlobs is passed -> the THIRD attempt is called with no options and its result is returned
T43: a seam that ALWAYS throws -> no-build-record, after all three attempts
T43: an error that is NOT a derivation failure propagates from the first attempt — it is not swallowed by the fallback
